101 / 101S3: Cortech Solstice Safeguard Bed
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-101-101s3-solstice-safetyguard-behavioral-health-bed-with-guardrails
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/beds/solstice-safeguard-bed/
Spec sheets: 101, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Solstice Safeguard Bed – 101 / 101S3
Current H1: Cortech Solstice Safetyguard Durable Behavioral Health Bed with Guardrails - 101 / 101S3
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded Bed with Raised Side Panels for Fall-Risk Patients, with Optional Ballast Doors
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 101 / 101S Solstice Safetyguard Bed - molded bed for fall-risk patients in behavioral health settings
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Solstice Safeguard Bed is the Solstice Bed with raised, molded-in wall panels along part of each side, to help keep fall-risk patients from falling out of bed. The partial panels add security without fully restricting movement.
The bed is rotationally molded as a single unit from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no seams, steel, or wood, and it fits a 36”×75” mattress. It can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes, or the 101S3 can be weighted with sandbags through underside ballast doors.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Dimensions: 80”L×36”W×27”H
Weight: 136 lbs
Side Panels: Raised, molded-in wall panels run partway along each side to reduce the risk of injury from falling
Mattress: Fits a 36”×75” mattress (sold separately)
Head and Footboards: Molded-in, raised head and footboards keep the mattress from sliding
Storage: No shelves or storage
Ballast Doors: The 101S3 has underside ballast doors for adding sandbags; do not use loose sand
Floor Mounting: Can be bolted to the floor through concealed pilot holes
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold
Easy Cleaning: Easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
101 – Standard: Without ballast doors
101S3 – With Ballast Doors: Underside ballast doors for adding sandbags
Installation and Options
Floor Mounting: Bolt to the floor through concealed pilot holes; see Cortech instructions. Hardware not included
Ballast Doors: Add sandbags through the underside ballast doors on the 101S3; do not use loose sand. Hardware bit size is T27
[H2] Applications
The Solstice Safeguard Bed suits patient rooms where residents are at risk of falling out of bed.
Typical applications include:
Rooms for fall-risk patients in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and other secure facilities
Cells and housing units in correctional facilities
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Patient Safety Beds and Bed Restraints collections for more beds and patient room furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Beds
Cortech beds are rotationally molded in one piece for patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and cells in correctional facilities, where beds must be safe, strong, and easy to clean.
Cortech beds include:
Solstice Series: The Solstice Bed, and the Solstice Safeguard Bed with raised side panels for fall-risk patients
Sequoia Series: Molded beds and night stands with a wood grain finish
Endurance Series: Endurance beds, wall mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (57 characters): Cortech Solstice Safeguard Bed - 101 / 101S3 at Anchortex
Meta description (148 characters): Shop the Cortech Solstice Safeguard Bed. A one-piece molded bed with raised side panels for fall-risk patients and optional underside ballast doors.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Beds" is a new section for the Solstice and Sequoia bed pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
H1: Cortech calls it the Solstice Safeguard Bed (your current page says "Safetyguard"). I took out "Durable," "Behavioral Health Bed," and "with Guardrails," since the side panels are molded in.
Weight: your variants are set to 150 lbs (101) and 145 lbs (101S3). The Cortech spec sheet says 136 lbs, so I used 136 lbs.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year factory warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I used that.
101S3: the Cortech spec sheet lists only the 101 and says the underside ballast doors are optional. It does not give a model number for the ballast door version, or say how many doors there are. I kept your 101S3 variant.
Colors: the Cortech spec sheet lists 18 colors on the first page and 12 on the second page. I used the 18.
Patent: your current page says "Patent Pending." The Cortech spec sheet gives a U.S. design patent number. I left both out.
I left out the noise test (RAL-AN23-010), since the Cortech spec sheet does not say this.
Antimicrobial: "Tested to ISO 22196" comes from the Cortech web page. The spec sheet has a "Now infused with antimicrobial compound" badge.
Product images: the page has two images: an Aqua bed photo and an older chart with 12 color dots. The Cortech product page has photos of the Safeguard Bed in 15 colors and one room photo. Would you like me to add them, and replace the chart with the 18-color chart?
